# Pulumi property map: Azure price-relevant inputs

Schema versions: azure (classic) 6.40.0, azure-native 3.28.0; retrieved 2026-10-02; Pulumi CLI v3.264.0.
All names are the Pulumi (camelCase) names used in YAML/TS and seen in `steps[].newState.inputs`. Source: `inputProperties` / `requiredInputs` / `types` of `pulumi package get-schema` output (files azure-schema.json, azure-native-schema.json). Enum lists exist only where the schema declares them; classic schema has plain strings, so allowed values are taken from the doc sentence. Arrays are flattened in paths (`agentPoolProfiles.vmSize` = `agentPoolProfiles[].vmSize`). Regenerated by build_map.py from flat/*.json.

- **sku**: sku.name (P1v3, S1, B1, Y1, EP1 ...), sku.tier, sku.capacity = worker count
